payload.claim: `finish_run`'s docstring cites `(item b-cafacd)` to support the sentence that a status outside `RUN_FINISHED_STATUSES` is refused before either write. `b-cafacd` (docs/backlog/b-cafacd-...) is about a different problem entirely: that `finish_run` previously appended no fact at all, so a folded ledger lost `SA-0126`'s cut-cap tracking, and about the row-commit-before-append ordering that explains why a refused append still leaves the status written. It says nothing about refusing an out-of-set status value, which is this task's own item `b-7431a2`. The citation points a future reader to the wrong record for the claim actually being made here.
